dedupe_keys.name: beni paesaggistici art 142 let l del d lgs 42 2004 vulcani

description: Beni paesaggistici art. 142 let. l del D.Lgs. 42/2004 – Vulcani is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by rsdi.regione.basilicata.it. The vector file concerns the delimitation of the volcanic layer of the Vulture, subject to protection under Article 142(1) of Legislative Decree No 42/2004 - Code of Cultural Heritage and Landscape. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Landscape assets, Article 142(l) of Legislative Decree No 42/2004 – Volcanoes" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Vincoli, Vulture, Piano Paesaggistico Basilicata, attività vulcanica, Vulcano, Paesaggio. The listing shows 3 download or service links in WMS, WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
